# Test Fixtures — Function Signature Documentation

Generated by reading source code. All field names verified against actual modules.

## 1. detection-confidence.js

**Main function:** `analyzeRequest(request, allRequests = [])`
**Source:** `backend/src/analyzers/detection-confidence.js`

### Input: `request` object shape
```
{
  url: string,              // Full URL
  pathname: string,         // URL pathname (used by L4)
  urlObj: URL,              // URL instance (used by L2 entropy, L5 fingerprint)
  vendor: string|null,      // Known vendor name (from categorizer)
  isResource: boolean,      // True if script/stylesheet load (L4 demotes)
  method: string,           // HTTP method (L1)
  resourceType: string,     // Puppeteer resource type: 'xhr','fetch','ping','image','script'... (L1)
  responseStatus: number,   // HTTP status code, 0 = blocked (L1)
  failed: boolean,          // True if request failed (L1)
  postData: string|null,    // POST body (L2)
  firedBeforeConsent: bool, // Pre-consent flag (L3)
  timestamp: number,        // Request time in seconds from page load (L3)
  pageLoadTimestamp: number  // Page load timestamp for delta calc (L3)
}
```

### Input: `allRequests` array
Array of request objects (same shape) — used by L3 behavioral clustering for same-host frequency.

### Output shape
```
{
  scores: {
    l4_semantic: number,     // 0-100
    l2_entropy: number,      // 0-100 (clamped from possibly negative raw)
    l1_protocol: number,     // 0-100
    l3_behavioral: number,   // 0-100
    l5_fingerprint: number   // 0-100
  },
  composite: number,         // 0-100 weighted sum (or 10 if consent ping)
  category: 'A'|'B'|'C',    // A≥70, B≥40, C<40
  isConsentPing: boolean,    // True if consent-only ping detected
  reason?: string            // Present only when isConsentPing=true
}
```

### Layer weights
- L4_SEMANTIC: 0.35
- L2_ENTROPY: 0.25
- L1_PROTOCOL: 0.15
- L3_BEHAVIORAL: 0.15
- L5_FINGERPRINT: 0.10

### Edge cases
- `urlObj` is null → L2 and L5 return 0
- Consent mode pings (gcs/gcd params, no non-consent params) → composite=10, category='C', isConsentPing=true
- `responseStatus === 0` → L1 penalizes by -50
- `failed === true` → L1 penalizes by -50
- Known vendor + resource load → L4 returns max(0, score - 40)

## 2. confirmed-tracking-filter.js

**Functions:** `buildMetricHierarchy(networkRequests, requestCategorization)`, `computeConfirmedTrackingViolations(networkRequests, requestCategorization)`
**Source:** `backend/src/analyzers/confirmed-tracking-filter.js`

### `buildMetricHierarchy` input
- `networkRequests`: Array of raw request objects from `network_requests_json` (shape from network-monitor.js — see below)
- `requestCategorization`: Parsed `request_categorization_json` object or null

### `requestCategorization` shape (from network-request-categorizer.js)
```
{
  categoryA: { count, requests: [{ url, ... }] },
  categoryB: { count, requests: [{ url, ... }] },
  categoryC: { count, requests: [{ url, ... }] },
  trackingRequests: [...],   // All Cat A+B
}
```

### `buildMetricHierarchy` output
```
{
  layer1: { count: number, label: string, legalStatus: string },
  layer2: { count: number, label: string, legalStatus: string },
  layer3: { count: number, label: string, legalStatus: string, isAuthoritative: true, requests: Array },
  internalControl: { exposureRate, exposureRatePct, detectionPrecision, detectionPrecisionPct, _note },
  funnelExplanation: string
}
```

### Layer 3 filter conditions (ALL must pass):
1. `req.beforeConsent === true` (truthy check)
2. NOT benign resource type: `['image','font','stylesheet','media','texttrack','manifest']`
   - Exception: `image` IS allowed if `url.search.length > 10` AND pathname matches TRACKING_PIXEL_PATHS
3. NOT benign extension: `.webp,.svg,.png,.jpg,.jpeg,.gif,.ico,.bmp,.tiff,.woff,.woff2,.ttf,.eot,.otf,.css,.mp4,.webm,.mp3,.ogg,.wav,.avif`
   - Exception: `.gif` IS allowed if `url.search.length > 10`
4. Must be Category A (URL in `catAUrls` set) — OR fallback to `req.isTracking === true` if no categorization data

### Fallback path
When `requestCategorization` is null/undefined → `catAUrls` and `categorizedUrls` are empty Sets → falls back to `req.isTracking === true`

## 3. compliance-score-calculator.js

**Main function:** `calculateOverallScore(auditResults)`
**Source:** `backend/src/analyzers/compliance-score-calculator.js`
**DB access:** NONE — pure function on data objects

### Input: `auditResults` shape
```
{
  policyAnalysis: { total_score, max_score, percentage } | null,
  bannerAnalysis: {
    bannerDetected: boolean,
    bannerDetectionStatus: { viewport: 'desktop'|'mobile' },
    totalChecks: number,
    passedCount: number,
    violations: [{ severity: 'critical'|'warning'|... }],
    hasCriticalViolations: boolean,
    violationCount: number,
    skippedCount: number
  } | null,
  consentSimulation: {
    success: boolean,
    comparison: { clickImbalance: number, violations: [...] }
  } | null,
  scanResults: {
    tracking_before_consent: boolean,
    cookies: Array
  } | null,
  consentModeAnalysis: {
    detected: boolean,
    compliant: boolean,
    implementationScore: number
  } | null,
  cookieComparison: {
    accuracyScore: number,
    matched: Array,
    totalDetected: number
  } | null
}
```

### Output shape
```
{
  overallScore: number,   // 0-100
  grade: string,          // 'A','B','C','D','F'
  components: {
    privacyPolicy: { score, contribution, details } | null,
    cookieBanner: { score, contribution, details },
    technical: { score, contribution, details },
    cookiePolicy: { score, contribution, details } | null
  },
  capsApplied: string[],
  weights: { privacyPolicy, cookieBanner, technical, cookiePolicy }
}
```

### Weights (default, all components present)
- privacyPolicy: 0.35, cookieBanner: 0.30, technical: 0.20, cookiePolicy: 0.15

### Weight redistribution
- No privacy policy: banner→0.45, technical→0.35, cookiePolicy→0.20
- No cookie policy (with privacy): privacy→0.40, banner→0.40, technical→0.20
- Both missing: banner→0.55, technical→0.45

### Grade boundaries
- A: ≥90, B: ≥75, C: ≥60, D: ≥40, F: <40

### Critical violation caps
- `tracking_before_consent === true` → max 55
- No consent mechanism (no cookies AND passedCount=0) → max 50
- Both → max 40

### Special cases
- `bannerDetected === false` → banner score = 0
- `bannerDetectionStatus.viewport === 'mobile'` → 50% penalty on banner score

## 4. Network request shape (from network-monitor.js)

```
{
  url: string,
  method: string,           // 'GET', 'POST', etc.
  resourceType: string,     // Puppeteer type: 'script','xhr','fetch','image','font','stylesheet','ping'...
  timestamp: number,        // Seconds from page load start
  beforeConsent: boolean,
  headers: Object,
  isTracking: boolean,
  domain: string|undefined, // Only set if isTracking
  responseStatus: number,   // Set by response handler, 0 if blocked/failed
  responseHeaders: Object,  // Set by response handler
  failed: boolean,          // Set by requestfailed handler
  failureText: string       // Set by requestfailed handler
}
```
